purpose: Fictional editorial style inspiration for the Dewdrop start page

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a portrait photo for the "Subtle definition" style card on Dewdrop, an understated Korean beauty app with cream, sage and dusty rose colors. Create a high-end, believable beauty editorial photograph of an adult East Asian man in his late twenties, an original fictional model. Natural groomed brows, barely perceptible soft brown upper lash definition, a soft natural satin complexion with visible pores and fine real skin texture, understated neutral lips. Short dark hair gently swept off the forehead. Calm open-eyed direct gaze, relaxed closed mouth, face almost frontal with a slight turn. Wearing a simple muted sage crewneck, just neckline and upper shoulders visible. Matte warm pale stone/cream seamless studio background. Large soft window light, subtle natural shadows, neutral warm color grading, professional quiet editorial treatment, no beauty filter. Portrait 4:5 composition, full head including hair with comfortable top margin, face centered horizontally, face is the focal point and occupies about 65 percent of image height, shoulders at bottom. This will be cropped to 4:5 in a small mobile card, so keep eyes, brows, cheeks and lips clearly readable and unobscured. Single photographic image edge to edge. No lettering, no labels, no logos, no UI, no circles, no markings, no props, no hands, no collage. Avoid exaggerated contour, glossy plastic skin, cartoon or illustration style, glamour pose, or celebrity likeness.
